name: Bun moc Kim Son
summary: Bún mọc Kim Sơn is noodles with pork balls. The 15 February 2023 culture page says the pork is leg meat, seasoned with nước mắm, pepper, and bột ngọt, spread on banana leaf, and boiled 7 to 10 minutes. The balls are about the size of a child’s fist.
howToEat: Eat it with the herbs that page lists: hoa chuối, kinh giới, tía tô, húng quê, giá, rau răm, lime or kumquat, chili vinegar, and pepper.
where: Kim Sơn. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Bun moc Kim Son — pork-ball noodles
seoDescription: Kim Sơn pork-ball noodles, boiled 7 to 10 minutes, with the herbs named on the 15 February 2023 page.
